title: Drizz's AI App Testing Ambition Meets Reality
hook_text: Drizz tests mobile apps with AI
script:
Drizz uses AI to test mobile apps through autonomous software testing agents.
The company published benchmark results measuring how well its agents perform.
Pass rates reached seventy two point three percent on the easier benchmark suite.
Performance dropped to twenty eight point seven percent on the harder suite.
Autonomous testing agents still face real limits in handling complex mobile tasks.
Will AI agents soon handle all mobile app testing tasks?
